notes: 2026-08-29 (branch `fix/e2e-health-gate-and-boxed01`, off master 5603ee63) — THE E2E DEPLOY-READINESS GATE IS NOW REAL. ci.yml's E2E job used to "Wait for API health": it polled the API service while every spec hits the WEB service, and on run 33263396288 it returned 200 in ONE SECOND from the previous deploy — the suite then ran against a web build that did not match the checkout (the deployed app served #474's NEW copy while the checked-out spec asserted the OLD one). It now blocks until the deployed WEB build matches github.sha, via a new apps/web/app/api/health/route.ts returning {status,sha,branch,timestamp} from RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA. force-dynamic + revalidate=0 are LOAD-BEARING (a prerendered copy would freeze the build-time SHA and wedge the gate). Railway injects RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA/RAILWAY_GIT_BRANCH into the RUNNING container but they do NOT appear in `railway variables` — absence there is NOT absence at runtime (verified via `railway ssh`). The gate deliberately does NOT require sha == github.sha: Railway deploys per service via watchPatterns, so an api-only push legitimately leaves web on an older commit; an older SHA passes ONLY when `git diff --name-only <deployed> <github.sha> -- apps/web packages` is EMPTY. That needs both commits, hence fetch-depth: 0 on the E2E job's checkout ONLY — without it the diff hits `fatal: bad object` and either false-reds every api-only push or silently degrades to always-pass. KNOWN GAP (stated, not hidden): the API is probed for REACHABILITY ONLY — app.service.ts exposes no SHA, so an api-only deploy in flight is undetected; close it by adding the field there, read at REQUEST time. Guard invariant for ci.yml: `^\s*run: npm ci --engine-strict=false` = 5 in ci.yml, 2 nightly, 2 post-deploy (raw count is also 5, measured — raw and run-step counts agree; --engine-strict=false is load-bearing vs root .npmrc engine-strict=true + prisma 7.10's node>=22 dev transitive on Node-20 runners). Context: post-deploy.yml has NEVER run (deploy hook never wired) and nightly.yml fails every night on Actions BILLING, not tests — the master-push E2E job is the ONLY E2E signal, and "nightly is authoritative" is false. || History in CHANGELOG.md (this directory).
